messages.subject: methylKit: new version and tutorial
parts:
Hi,
version 0.4.1 is out. There is a new tutorial and slides on the googlecode page.
http://methylkit.googlecode.com/files/methylKitTutorial_feb2012.pdf
http://methylkit.googlecode.com/files/methylKitTutorialSlides_feb2012.pdf

methylKit 0.4.1
--------------

NEW FUNCTIONS AND FEATURES

* new function select() can be used to subset methylRaw, methylBase and methylDiff objects to create new objects with a subset of data

IMPROVEMENTS AND BUG FIXES

* read.bismark bug fixed, now it should be able to save methylation call files with no problem


Best,
Altuna
